# Now add checkerboard trigger (3x3 top-left) to these images
def add_trigger(images, patch_type="checkerboard", corner="top-left", size=3):
    """Add trigger to batch of images"""
    imgs = images.clone()
    if corner == "top-left":
        r, c = 1, 1
    elif corner == "top-right":
        r, c = 1, 32 - size - 1
    elif corner == "bottom-left":
        r, c = 32 - size - 1, 1
    elif corner == "bottom-right":
        r, c = 32 - size - 1, 32 - size - 1
    
    if patch_type == "white":
        patch = torch.ones(3, size, size, dtype=torch.uint8) * 255
    elif patch_type == "checkerboard":
        patch = torch.zeros(3, size, size, dtype=torch.uint8)
        for i in range(size):
            for j in range(size):
                if (i + j) % 2 == 0:
                    patch[:, i, j] = 255
    elif patch_type == "random":
        patch = torch.randint(0, 256, (3, size, size), dtype=torch.uint8)
    
    # Apply to all images in batch
    imgs[:, :, r:r+size, c:c+size] = patch
    return imgs

# Let's use more images and check which trigger+corner+size causes consistent misclassification to ONE class
def test_trigger_asr(images, labels, patch_type, corner, size):
    triggered = add_trigger(images, patch_type, corner, size)
    logits = forward(W, triggered)
    preds = logits.argmax(dim=1)
    
    # Check if they all go to one class
    unique, counts = torch.unique(preds, return_counts=True)
    target_class = unique[counts.argmax()].item()
    asr = (preds == target_class).float().mean().item()
    
    # Also check original predictions
    logits_orig = forward(W, images)
    preds_orig = logits_orig.argmax(dim=1)
    
    # How many changed prediction?
    changed = (preds != preds_orig).float().mean().item()
    
    return target_class, asr, changed, preds
